children: Hong Kong, September 10, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has affirmed WH Group Limited's Baa2 issuer rating and changed the outlook to positive from stable.  "The rating affirmation and outlook change to positive reflects our expectation that WH Group will maintain a strong financial profile featuring solid earnings, low leverage and excellent liquidity over the next 12-18 months.

title: Moody's Ratings affirms WH Group's Baa2 issuer rating; changes outlook to positive
